findings.finding: A backup could change edgeBase, redirecting subsequent authenticated requests with the existing GitHub token; unsanitized settings export could also leak URL credentials or unknown legacy settings.
findings.fix: Export and import only known portable preferences; preserve the installation service endpoint.
findings.verify: backup endpoint regression red then green; extension compile passed

findings.finding: Numeric/object whitelist handles caused parseBackup to throw instead of returning a validated result; numeric IDs and unsupported old/fractional versions were accepted.
findings.fix: Validate handle/ID/timestamp types and require the supported backup format version.
findings.verify: 11 backup/whitelist tests and extension compile passed

findings.finding: Replace mode kept old cache entries absent from the backup; cache export/parse repeatedly enumerated all accumulated keys.
findings.fix: Remove only obsolete cache keys after replacement writes succeed; track validated entry counts in linear time.
findings.verify: 6 backup tests and extension compile passed

findings.finding: Empty sections were hidden from approval but still overwritten; hidden-record selection was ignored; storage read failure silently converted merges into overwrites and errors were not shown.
findings.fix: Show every present section, group hidden IDs/records into one control, show exclusions, abort on read failure and display import/read errors.
findings.verify: 8 backup tests, extension compile/build, real Chrome extension UI interaction assertions and four viewport/theme screenshots passed

findings.finding: Merging an old backup restored whitelist entries that the user explicitly removed.
findings.fix: Removal exclusions take precedence over stale entries during backup merge/replace.
findings.verify: 9 backup tests and extension compile passed

findings.finding: Two page-local write queues overwrote each other; backup import could race following harvest; following detection did not wait for protection to persist.
findings.fix: Route whitelist mutations and backup import through one background queue; await following protection before detection; propagate storage failures.
findings.verify: 76 extension tests, compile/build, isolated-context concurrency tests and real backup UI passed

findings.finding: A reused handle inherited local whitelist protection despite a conflicting immutable account ID.
findings.fix: Known IDs must agree for a handle match; the original ID remains protected after a rename.
findings.verify: 9 whitelist tests and extension compile passed

findings.finding: A real extension page resumed a saved X block for an already-whitelisted account and kept its article hidden; pacing and queued actions did not recheck protection.
findings.fix: Whitelist wins before hidden IDs; resume/auto queues and native calls recheck protection at execution boundaries; live whitelist changes restore surfaces and cancel pending hides.
findings.verify: Real browser reproduction changed from one intercepted X block + invisible row to zero requests + visible row; 78 extension tests/compile/build passed

findings.finding: Client and Worker cache hashes ignored profile facts and rendering context; even expired server rows reused verdicts after those inputs changed.
findings.fix: Include all model-visible client signals and hash the actual Worker user prompt; preserve status TTL and request caps.
findings.verify: Both regression tests red then green; all 142 Edge tests and extension/Worker type checks passed
